resolved_findings.resolution: The effect-cycle barrier prevents subsequent Q/P forwarding until the corresponding ReadyForQuery and intervening lexical ParameterStatus have been validated. An older completion retains newer pending effects. This closes the observed pg_settings pipeline gap within the declared trusted-engine boundary without relying on a complete SQL-effect blacklist.

design_assessment: Native PREPARE/EXECUTE retains exact whole-source acceptance, sole top-level classification, shared connection-local accepted provenance, conservative ASCII names and restrictions within bodies and parameter expressions.
Pending effects are marked before Q/E forwarding. Sync/Flush/COPY/Close/Describe/cancellation and already-admitted Bind/Execute remain available for progress.
A denied Q/P closes the connection; a later successful query is tested on a session that has not already been rejected.
Six cycle propositions explicitly distinguish pending denial, unvalidated completion, preservation of newer effects and successful completed-cycle release.
implementation_acceptance_notes: Conservatively reject protocol prepared statement names longer than63UTF8bytes, consistent with conservative policy, to avoid backend/local name-alias discrepancies. Check limits on every name-reference path; test same-prefix names and mixed SQL/protocol operations.

Exercise prior Sync cycle0 then newer Execute cycle1: Ready0 must leave cycle1 pending and Q/P denied. Only the corresponding validated Ready1 may release a non-rejected session. Mark pending before forward; do not let unrelated startup/stale Ready release it.

Test delayed/fragmented unsafe ParameterStatus, UPDATE pg_settings followed by new SQL, normal P/B/E/Sync completion, COPY progress, cancellation, portal suspension, and later E while an older cycle remains pending.

Preserve unchanged pg_dump/pg_restore ACL contents and test both cross-protocol PREPARE/Bind/EXECUTE directions, failed or duplicate preparation, unknown targets, cached Execute on a fresh connection, quoted/Unicode/overlong names and nested/multiple SQL rejection.

Keep classification, native name normalization, exact body token-span extraction and state-generation association fail closed; do not infer a backend object or successful execution solely from optimistic accepted provenance.

formal_review.required_gate: After all six council seats, run the final two clean builds bound to this exact spec and source before production changes.

formal_limits: bodyPart proves only nonempty substring membership. Correct native PREPARE classification/body extraction/name resolution remain trusted adapter obligations.

CycleState abstracts pending cycle IDs. Correct monotone assignment, ordered Q/Sync acknowledgement matching, ParameterStatus validation and Python concurrency refinement remain implementation obligations.
The proof establishes exact admitted provenance and abstract barriers, not PostgreSQL execution, SQL semantic equivalence, network isolation or commercial rights.
approval_scope: Exact revision5 design. Final proof-first closure and runtime/database/recovery/HTTP/ML-integrity acceptance remain separate gates.
